notes.title: Patch Update Notes for February 3rd
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 5 new levels.
[*] Added zoom and screen movement functions to the animation interactions.
[*] Fixed some bugs reported by players in the mini-games, such as voiceover errors and incorrect ball synthesis.
[*] Replaced the overall art assets for the balls.
[*] Introduced achievements.
[*] Added beginner's guide content to the mini-game interface.
[/list]
